commit.merge_subject: merge: pure hevc preflight decision model

description:
the b5 first deliverable, new files only — no encoder edits, no
device calls. home: the export/ package's new hevc/ subpackage
(com.ritim.ritimcraw.export.hevc), export being the natural
neighbor of the thing being decided.

HevcProfile.kt — the output-profile contract model, android-free
(the framework constants carried as data, verified against the
installed android-34 sdk jar — the minsdk — and the android-36
sources). four DISTINCT values, never one hdr toggle:
- AVC_SDR: today's baseline for comparison, byte-for-byte the
  writer's videoFormat contract (video/avc, AVCProfileHigh=8 +
  AVCLevel41, BT709/SMPTE170m/limited, 8-bit).
- HEVC10_SDR: Main10 (profile 2), 10-bit, still SMPTE170m/BT709,
  no hdr gate, no static metadata — 10-bit is NOT the same
  feature as hdr.
- HLG: Main10 + ARIB STD-B67 (transfer 7), BT2020, scene-referred
  (no hdr-static-info); gates on FEATURE_HlgEditin
